fields.description: Denormalized from Guest — lets a direct history query filter without a join, same rationale as Resource Disk Sample.monitored_host.
fields.label: Server

fields.description: Denormalized from Guest — keeps history queryable by VMID even after Proxmox stops reporting the guest and the live Proxmox Guest row is auto-deleted.
fields.label: VMID

fields.description: Genuine append-only history, server clock at ingest time. Only ever purged by purge_old_resource_history (Resource History Retention (days), on Proxmox Monitor Settings).
fields.label: Collected At

fields.description: Live Poll rows come from the ongoing background poller (one row per Resource History Sample Interval). RRD Backfill rows were imported once from Proxmox's own built-in RRD history, and are typically spaced much further apart — kept distinct so a chart doesn't misread the density change as a data gap.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: QEMU: only when the guest agent responded (best-effort — Proxmox can't see inside a VM's filesystem without it). LXC: real value whenever Proxmox reports a disk size for the container.
fields.label: Disk Usage

fields.description: LXC containers report real cgroup swap usage, which genuinely draws on host swap. Always null for QEMU VMs — Proxmox's API has no way to read swap inside a VM without invasive guest-agent command execution, which this app deliberately doesn't do.
fields.label: Swap Usage
